newsitem.title: USA: BrandyWine Realty files $500 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: BrandyWine Realty files $500 mln shelf.

text.p: BrandyWine Realty Trust on Monday said it filed a shelf registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up $500 million in preferred and common shares, and warrants of beneficial interest.

The company will use net proceeds for general business purposes including repayment of certain outstanding debt and the acquisition of office and industrial properties, the Newtown Square, Pa.,-based company said.
BrandyWine is a self-administered, self-managed fully integrated real estate investment trust engaged in the ownership, management leasing, acquisition and development of office properties.
